title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Invisible longing

lines.l: I don't want that anybody sees, but I keep your name
Like a dime in my coat
If the world can't see it
I sold my last whiskey at the county fair
Spun that old pickup like I didn't care
But every red dirt mile had you ghosting the roots
A quiet kind of hunger, I can't get enough
I don't need proof, I don't need a sign
Things pull harder when they stay inside
Invisible longing, it rides with me
If the world can't see it, I can still feel it
Invisible longing, oh, keeps me on my feet
So I sing to the dark, let her know my name
Her man can be empty and still not break
I'll follow that ache like a northbound light
What she can't hold down still keeps you alive
If the world can't see it
The lights flash, the bass vibrates
The dance floor fills, the energy soars
